result:
The password change feature is written, but nothing has been run (no tests, lint or app, as you asked), so it is unverified.

What a user sees: a "Change Password" button next to "Update Profile" on the profile page opens a drawer with three fields - current password, new password, confirm new password. A wrong current password shows an error toast, "The current password is incorrect", and the drawer stays open. On success the drawer closes with a "Password Updated" toast.

- **Mock API**: new `PATCH /users/password` handler in `src/testing/mocks/handlers/users.ts`. It compares the hash of the current password with the stored one and only then saves the new hash.
- **Status code**: a wrong password returns 400, not 401, because the API client redirects to the login page on any 401.
- **Validation**: the new password needs at least 5 characters (same minimum as login and register), and the two entries must match. The confirmation is checked on the client only and is not sent to the API.
- **Feature code**: `src/features/users/api/change-password.ts` (schema, fetcher, mutation hook with the success notification) and `src/features/users/components/change-password.tsx`, composed in `src/app/routes/app/profile.tsx`.
- **Test**: I added `src/app/routes/app/__tests__/profile.test.tsx`, covering the wrong-password rejection, the successful change and the mismatch error.
